Masterclass

Makeup Masterclass

An intensive hands-on masterclass designed to elevate your personal beauty routine. Master colour theory for makeup, bespoke foundation matching, eyeshadow techniques for your unique eye shape, and flawless daily application tailored to your personal seasonal palette.

Learn step-by-step master techniques directly from our lead analysts. Bring your personal makeup pouch for a complete audit: discard conflicting shades and discover how to blend formulas that enhance your features effortlessly.

What to Expect
  • Hands-on colour theory for makeup — learn which pigment families harmonize with your seasonal palette.
  • Bespoke foundation matching and eyeshadow techniques tailored to your unique eye shape and skin undertone.
  • Personal makeup pouch audit: identify conflicting shades and learn to blend formulas that enhance your features.
Duration: 120 minutes
Location: ASHTA District 8, SCBD, Jakarta
Investment: IDR 3.000.000
